verdict.rationale: PostHog exposes a very broad API surface (OpenAPI spec, personal API keys with granular scopes, a query endpoint for arbitrary SQL/HogQL, an MCP server with 953 tools across 65 product categories, and a CLI/wizard covering most UI-visible products), and probes confirm live OAuth-gated MCP and OpenAPI endpoints — strong evidence of near-parity between API/agent access and the UI. However, the docs themselves admit gaps (query endpoint 'not a supported export mechanism', pagination limits) and one community report describes the AI/LLM interface failing on a specific cohort-creation task, showing real-world friction rather than perfect parity. Missing for 10: independent third-party confirmation of full UI/API feature parity, and resolution of the documented API limitations/community failure report.
